backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with all user, provider, client, job, document, stats, and MPesa configuration types, including engagementEndTime and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Provides migration logic converting old stored actor data into the new schema, adding engagementEndTime to provider profiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to frontend files, components, and test IDs with high-confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-generated summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file across pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining color variables for light/dark themes and applying base UI styles.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template setting up PWA metadata, icons, and loading the React entrypoint.
frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains: Domain configuration file listing the Internet Computer canister domain.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app metadata, icons, theme colors, and display settings.
frontend/public/offline.html: Standalone offline fallback page shown when the user has no internet connection.
frontend/public/sw.js: Implements a service worker that precaches core assets, serves navigation fallbacks offline, and uses cache-first for static files while bypassing backend calls and well‑known paths.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up React Query, authentication state, navigation, and page routing, including service worker registration and onboarding logic.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main page layout with header, footer, and support drawer around page content.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/auth/PhoneOtpVer: Manages phone OTP sending and verification UI with error and success handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Allows new users to select and submit a role, creating minimal profiles and updating backend state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders footer with copyright, support trigger, and a referral link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Displays navigation, role‑based menu items, logo, login button, and a mobile menu sheet.
frontend/src/components/landing/DemoVide: Shows a placeholder section for a future demo video on the landing page.
frontend/src/components/landing/Platform: Displays animated client and provider stats with minimum thresholds and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/components/landing/RoleQuic: Provides quick role selection with login handling, navigation, and disabled states.
frontend/src/components/landing/Testimon: Renders a grid of static client testimonials with ratings and provider avatars.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Allows users to enter or auto-detect their location using browser geolocation.
frontend/src/components/messaging/Conver: Implements a simple messaging UI with local message state, send, and refresh simulation.
frontend/src/components/notifications/En: Shows a temporary alert indicating whether a provider is engaged or not, with auto-hide.
frontend/src/components/payments/MpesaUn: Handles M-Pesa payment flow to unlock provider contact details with simulated processing.
frontend/src/components/providers/Featur: Renders a provider avatar with fallback initials and size options, handling image load errors.
Displays a grid of demo featured providers with avatars, ratings, and details using card components.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Shows a provider avatar with optional profile image and fallback initials in multiple sizes.
Card component showing provider info, rating, verification status, and avatar, with optional click handling.
Dialog previewing key provider details including avatar, verification, ratings, and availability.
frontend/src/components/providers/Unlock: Card explaining locked contact details and connection fee with an action button to unlock.
frontend/src/components/pwa/InstallPromp: Banner prompting users to install the PWA, including iOS-specific installation instructions.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Displays average rating with full, half, or empty stars and the total ratings count.
Interactive 1–5 star input component with optional read‑only mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Provides a drawer UI component showing customer support phone and email details with contact links.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUpOnVisible.t: Implements a count‑up animation that starts when the referenced element becomes visible via IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, providing login, logout, and identity loading via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePWAInstallPrompt.t: Handles detection and triggering of PWA installation prompts, including special handling for iOS.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, OTP flows, location updates, and other backend interactions using an actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and theme variables, defines light/dark color palettes, and styles landing page backgrounds.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines the Category interface and exports a list of service categories with IDs, labels, business types, and icons.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers, rendering the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ClientAccessPage: Provides client login and account creation flow using Internet Identity and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ProviderAccessPa: Provides service provider login and account creation flow with Internet Identity and phone OTP verification.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Displays a placeholder admin page for reviewing and verifying provider accounts.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Shows a searchable grid of service categories and navigates to results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/ClientProfileP: Client profile page that loads user data, lets clients update their pinned location, and displays phone and verification info.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Placeholder map view page showing category name and a notice that map functionality is not yet available.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Jobs page placeholder showing upcoming job management features and a link to browse services.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays detailed provider info with live updates, engagement status detection, ratings, and unlock/payment interactions.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Provider results page with preview modal, engagement status tracking, and navigation to detail or map view; currently uses an empty provider list.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing landing page with hero content, navigation logic, and multiple feature sections.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Provider profile page for updating pinned location and managing engagement status with validation and mutation calls.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Displays provider verification status and a placeholder for future document upload functionality.
frontend/src/utils/engagementTime.ts: Utility functions to compute and format remaining engagement time and check expiration.
frontend/src/utils/fees.ts: Provides helpers to compute a 10% connection fee from a bigint rate and to format KES amounts for display.
Stores, retrieves, validates, and clears a pending user role in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL parameters (including hash routes), persisting them in sessionStorage, and clearing stored or hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Captures the project’s current state, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature records for the Genz App.
